_meta.note: Fact base for Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd (TMPVL, formerly Tata Motors Ltd; NSE: TMPV; Screener symbol TMPV, consolidated). Rs crore unless stated; JLR figures in GBP m (IFRS). Every item has src + published (date).

ar26.what: Integrated Annual Report FY2025-26 (accounts approved 14-May-2026; report filed before the AGM)

profile.what: Two businesses after the Oct-2025 demerger of commercial vehicles: (1) Jaguar Land Rover (JLR, 100% via TML Holdings, UK; Range Rover, Defender, Discovery, Jaguar; 307.9k wholesales in FY26, 81% of revenue); (2) Tata Passenger Vehicles in India (Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles standalone + Tata Passenger Electric Mobility (TPEML, EVs) + 50% joint operation FIAPL; 641.6k wholesales in FY26, #2 in India on Vahan registrations in H2FY26, ~40% EV market share). Plus 53.35% of listed Tata Technologies (TTL) and 50% of Chery Jaguar Land Rover (China JV, equity-accounted).

segmentsFY26.note: Company EBITDA includes grant income/incentives (PLI, JLR R&D credits) and excludes unrealised FX/commodity; Screener's operating profit (Rs18,719 cr) = company EBITDA - grants + unrealised FX/commodity (-590).

netDebt._note: Company definition: borrowings incl. leases less cash, bank balances and liquid mutual funds (Rs K cr). Entities: JLR, India PV (standalone PV + TPEML + FIAPL), TML Holdings (JLR's holdco), Others (mainly TTL net cash).

callPoints: JLR: wholesales -9% to 79.3k on a fire at a chassis supplier (several days of Solihull production lost), the Middle East conflict and the planned run-out of old Jaguars; China wholesales -25%. VME up to 7.1% of revenue from 4.1%.
JLR: FY27 guidance (revenue ~GBP26bn, EBIT margin c.4%, investment GBP3.7bn, free cash flow breakeven) not changed, but 'will require strong performance for the remainder of the year' (CFO).

JLR: Range Rover Electric production from Sep-2026; Range Rover Sport Electric later this year; Range Rover GT and Jaguar Type 01 early next year (no material FY27 volume); ~12,000 EVs pencilled for FY27.

JLR: GBP1.7bn two-year cost programme to bring breakeven back towards 300k units; MoU with Stellantis for US-built vehicles, definitive agreement targeted by end-2026; credit ratings at the investment-grade border on negative watch.
India: volumes +46% vs industry +24%; Vahan share 14.3%; EVs ~20% of sales (24% in July), EV bookings ~3.5x pre-crisis levels; production ramping to 65-70k a month; dealer stock ~30 days.

India: commodity inflation hit 4.5% in Q1 with another ~3% in Q2; price rises of 0.5% in April and July; Q2 margin guided 'flattish' vs Q1; most of the portfolio PLI-certified by Q4; Avinya EV moved to the CJLR Freelander platform and slips to 2027.

guidance.said: Revenue ~GBP26bn (FY26 GBP23bn), EBIT margin c.4% (FY26 >0%), investment GBP3.7bn, operating cash flow breakeven (FY26 -GBP2.3bn). Revenue growth ambition +10% a year FY27-FY32.
guidance.outcome: Q1FY27: revenue GBP6.0bn (-9.6%), EBIT 2.8%, FCF -GBP1.0bn; guidance retained on 13-Aug-2026

guidance.said: GBP1.7bn of savings over two years (ex-works cost, warranty, fixed cost) to return breakeven towards 300k units; investment GBP18bn over the five years from FY24.

Volumes 640k (FY26) to 1.2mn+ (FY31), ~15% CAGR, market share towards 20%; FY29 revenue Rs115K cr+, EBITDA 8%, EBIT 4%; FY31 revenue Rs140K cr, EBITDA 10%, EBIT 5%+ after PLI ends; capex ~7% of revenue (Rs37.5-40K cr, front-loaded); cumulative FCF Rs10K cr+ (marginally negative in early years).
'Higher double-digit' volume growth; offset commodities through price rises and cost cuts; margins to step up in H2 with PLI on new products.

history: Tata Motors buys Jaguar Land Rover from Ford
JLR becomes ~3/4 of group revenue; GBP results drive the stock
Acquires Ford's Sanand car plant (Tata Passenger Electric Mobility)
Second car plant in Gujarat for the EV subsidiary
Private investors subscribe to compulsorily convertible preference shares (CCPS) of TPEML, the EV subsidiary
CCPS liability Rs2,286 cr at Mar-26; investors will own a minority of TPEML
Tata Technologies IPO
Stake now 53.35%; listed value Rs15,329 cr at the 30-Sep-2026 close
DVR shares cancelled (equity capital Rs767 cr to Rs736 cr)
Single class of shares
Tata Motors Finance merged into Tata Capital
Tata Capital shares went with the CV business in the demerger
Cyber attack: JLR shuts all plants for September, restarts manufacturing 8-Oct-2025, normal by mid-November
Q2-Q3FY26 JLR EBIT -8.6% / -6.8%; Rs2,786 cr exceptional cost; FY26 JLR FCF -GBP2.2bn
Demerger of commercial vehicles effective (record date 14-Oct-2025, 1:1); company renamed Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd (13-Oct-2025); CV company (TMCV) listed 12-Nov-2025
Rs82,616 cr non-cash gain booked in FY26 profit (no effect on net worth); history before FY25 includes CV
Nov-2025 to Jun-2026
New leaders: Shailesh Chandra MD & CEO (Oct-2025); P B Balaji JLR CEO; Dhiman Gupta CFO (Nov-2025)
Investor days 17 and 23 Jun-2026 set targets

management.chairman: N Chandrasekaran (Tata Sons chairman; takes no commission)
management.jlrCeo: P B Balaji (non-executive director of TMPVL from 17-Nov-2025)
management.independents: Om Prakash Bhatt (retired Mar-2026), Vedika Bhandarkar, Al-Noor Ramji, Usha Sangwan, Bharat Puri, Sudha Krishnan

accounting: FY26 profit (Rs82,390 cr attributable) includes the CV business's H1 profit (Rs1,406 cr after tax) and an Rs82,616 cr non-cash gain on the demerger; continuing operations lost Rs1,632 cr after Rs4,142 cr of exceptional items (cyber Rs2,786 cr, separation Rs1,044 cr, demerger costs Rs422 cr).
Reported EPS for FY26 is -Rs0.61 on continuing + discontinued operations in the annual report; Screener shows Rs223.74 because it includes the demerger gain.

JLR is reported under IFRS in GBP; group accounts are Ind AS. Company EBITDA includes grants (PLI Rs1,044 cr in FY26 for India PV; R&D credits at JLR) and product development expense; JLR capitalises ~64-74% of engineering spend.
Deferred tax asset rose to Rs14,976 cr (Mar-26) as JLR UK losses were recognised; FY26 tax credit Rs246 cr.
